info.title: IA4S Frontend Characterization API
info.description: Machine-readable v0 contract for the separate original Airis frontend. Laravel owns persistence, validation, job dispatch, and Python adapter calls; the frontend must not call the Python service directly.

servers.description: Private development VPS using Laravel auth

get.description: Returns the P5-P10 workflow order, source-present/pending-integration frontend metadata, primary endpoints, supported backend capabilities, gate status, and explicit limitations for the separate original Airis frontend. The route requires Laravel auth; in private-dev mode Laravel can auto-authenticate the configured technical user.
Returns a paginated list of NACE codes. The route requires Laravel auth; in private-dev mode Laravel can auto-authenticate the configured technical user.
Returns a paginated list of AR16/ESRS topic candidates. The route requires Laravel auth; in private-dev mode Laravel can auto-authenticate the configured technical user.
Returns Level A/B/C progressive-disclosure dictionaries. The frontend should consume these keys instead of hardcoding backend option values.

200.description: Current characterization for the authenticated user, or null when none exists.

put.description: Saves draft state without dispatching the processing job. Partial step payloads are accepted where Laravel validation allows them.

post.description: Creates or updates the current user's characterization, marks it submitted, resets retry metadata, clears stale results, sets submitted_at, and dispatches SubmitCharacterizationJob. The endpoint defaults action=submit and step=review. For JSON API submits, esrs_topic_ids is optional so the frontend can request an AI P6 proposal from the P5 company/operations profile. If the current characterization is already submitted, waiting, or processing, submit is idempotent: Laravel returns the current state with retry metadata intact and does not dispatch a duplicate job or mutate the in-flight payload. When the job completes with result_data.candidate_topics, Laravel persists candidate ar16_topic_id values into esrs_topic_ids and form_data.esg_focus.topic_ids.

get.summary: Get normalized P6 AI materiality proposal
get.description: Returns the current user's P6 materiality proposal for the separate frontend. The endpoint does not call Python; it reads persisted esrs_topic_ids, topic summaries, stored proposal review actions, AI candidate_topics, manual-review prediction keys, and readiness for P8 confirmation.

200.description: Current P6 proposal state, or null when no characterization exists.

put.description: Stores Phase 2 review traceability for the current completed P6 proposal. The characterization must be completed and must have at least one proposal topic; otherwise Laravel returns HTTP 422 with a validation error keyed by characterization. This does not overwrite the final P8 materiality confirmation.

get.description: Returns a static structured JSON guide for the external double materiality assessment between P6 and P8. The endpoint avoids Markdown, does not call Python, and does not decide materiality.
Returns a header-only CSV template for off-app ADM work. The endpoint is deterministic, authenticated, does not call Python, and supports the same template keys returned by the guide payload.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment filename for the selected template.

get.description: Returns the current user's P8 confirmation state. If no P8 confirmation has been stored yet, confirmed_topic_ids defaults to the P6 proposed esrs_topic_ids and confirmation_status is defaulted_from_p6. An explicit stored empty confirmed_topic_ids array is confirmation_status=confirmed.

200.description: Current P8 confirmation state, or null when no characterization exists.

put.description: Stores the user's final P8 material topic set, delta reasons, and optional notes in the current characterization form_data. Requires a completed P6 characterization with at least one proposed topic. confirmed_topic_ids must be present and may be empty. change_reasons/change_reason_notes keys must be canonical positive topic-id strings from the current P6/P8 topic union. If P6 proposed E1 and final P8 removes all E1 topics, e1_not_material_explanation is required.

get.description: Returns a frontend-ready P8 decision sheet summary for the current user's characterization. It packages confirmation status, P6 vs P8 delta, change reasons, optional E1 explanation, and orientative P9 preview. When confirmation_status is defaulted_from_p6, the sheet is preview-only and must not be treated as final external ADM evidence. The endpoint does not generate a PDF and does not call Python.

200.description: Current P8 decision sheet, or null when no characterization exists.

get.description: Returns the P9 datapoint corpus for the current user's characterization. The corpus is built from final P8 topic IDs when available, otherwise P6 proposed topic IDs, and uses EFRAG IG 3 at standard-level granularity.

200.description: Current deterministic P9 datapoint corpus, or null when no characterization exists.

get.summary: Get editable P9 datapoint response state
get.description: Returns frontend-entered P9 datapoint responses for the current user's characterization, filtered to the current deterministic corpus. The endpoint does not call Python.

200.description: Current P9 response state, or null when no characterization exists.

put.description: Stores frontend-entered response state under the current characterization form_data. Every submitted datapoint_id must belong to the current deterministic P9 corpus. The endpoint does not call Python.

404.description: No characterization exists for the authenticated user.

get.summary: Download editable P9 datapoint responses CSV
get.description: Returns the current P9 corpus plus frontend-entered response state as a flattened CSV attachment. The export includes every currently applicable datapoint, response fields when present, and applicability why fields. The endpoint does not call Python.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment filename for the response CSV export.

404.description: No characterization exists for the authenticated user.

get.summary: Download deterministic ESRS datapoint corpus CSV
get.description: Returns the current P9 datapoint corpus as a flattened CSV attachment. It uses the same deterministic builder as GET /api/esrs-datapoints, does not call Python, and shares the same current mapping granularity.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment filename for the CSV export.

404.description: No characterization exists for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns report-package readiness for the final Informe step. The endpoint does not generate the final AI report, does not call Python, and exposes available support/download endpoints plus remaining blockers.

200.description: Report-package readiness, or null when no characterization exists.

get.description: Returns deterministic report draft data for the final Informe step. The endpoint does not generate the final AI report or XBRL package; the separate frontend renders the draft from this JSON.

200.description: Report draft data, or null when no characterization exists.

laravelSession.name: laravel_session
laravelSession.description: Laravel authenticated user. In private-dev mode, PRIVATE_DEV_AUTO_LOGIN can satisfy this for private dev verification without showing a Laravel login screen.

sections.description: Readiness sections keyed by workflow step. materiality_proposal.status is ready only when the current P6 topic list is non-empty. materiality_confirmation.status is ready when confirmed_topic_ids is explicitly present, even if it is an empty array.

next_actions.description: Ordered endpoints for incomplete upstream workflow sections. When all inputs are ready and final generation is still pending, this returns /api/report/draft.

materiality.description: Materiality summary including is_confirmed and confirmation_status. confirmed_topic_count may be 0 for an explicit confirmed no-topical-materiality outcome.

not_applicable_count.description: Responses marked not_applicable. These count as decided for report readiness.

completion_ratio.description: decided_count divided by total_datapoint_count, rounded to 4 decimals.

status.description: Readiness of the downloadable/support artifact for report use. The endpoint may exist even when status is incomplete or blocked.

enum: Laravel web session with private-dev auto-login

required_fields.description: Submit-required characterization fields enforced by the backend validator.

draft_clearable_fields.description: Fields that may be cleared during draft saves using null or empty arrays.

esrs_topic_ids.description: Optional for POST /api/characterization/submit when the frontend is asking Laravel/Python to generate the P6 AI proposal. If provided, values must be existing ESRS topic IDs.

ready_for_confirmation.description: True when a completed characterization has at least one current P6 proposal topic. This is readiness to move into P8 confirmation; it does not mean the P6 review map is complete.

MaterialityProposalReviewRequest.description: Review action write payload. The current characterization must be completed and have at least one current proposal topic before this payload is accepted.

topic_actions.description: Object keyed by canonical positive integer strings for topic ids in the current P6 proposal. Malformed keys such as 4abc, 4.9, 04, 0, or negative values are rejected.

action_reasons.description: Object keyed by canonical positive integer strings for topic ids in the current P6 proposal.

action_notes.description: Object keyed by canonical positive integer strings for topic ids in the current P6 proposal.

MaterialityProposalReview.description: Review state filtered to the current P6 proposal topic ids. Stored actions for stale proposal topics are not returned and do not contribute to review status.

topic_actions.description: Current-proposal action map keyed by canonical positive integer topic id strings.

action_reasons.description: Current-proposal reason map keyed by canonical positive integer topic id strings.

action_notes.description: Current-proposal note map keyed by canonical positive integer topic id strings.

MaterialityConfirmationStatus.description: defaulted_from_p6 means no explicit P8 confirmation has been stored and the response defaults to the P6 proposal; confirmed means confirmed_topic_ids was explicitly stored, including an empty array.

is_confirmed.description: True only when the user has explicitly stored a final P8 confirmation. Empty confirmed_topic_ids can still be confirmed.

confirmed_topic_ids.description: Current P8 topic ids. Defaults to P6 proposed topics when confirmation_status is defaulted_from_p6; may be an empty array when confirmation_status is confirmed.

propertyNames.description: Canonical positive ESRS topic id string from the current P6/P8 topic union.
Canonical positive ESRS topic id string from the current P6/P8 topic union.

MaterialityConfirmationRequest.description: Requires a completed P6 characterization with at least one proposed topic. confirmed_topic_ids must be present and may be empty for an explicit no-topical-materiality ADM outcome. change_reasons and change_reason_notes keys must be canonical topic ids from the current P6/P8 union.

confirmed_topic_ids.description: Required array of final P8 ESRS topic ids. It may be empty when the final external ADM finds no topical standards material.

propertyNames.description: Canonical positive ESRS topic id string from the current P6/P8 topic union.
Canonical positive ESRS topic id string from the current P6/P8 topic union.

is_confirmed.description: True only when a final P8 confirmation has been stored. False decision sheets are preview-only defaults from P6.

note.description: Confirmed sheets state that selections reflect the external ADM; defaulted_from_p6 sheets state they are preview-only defaults from P6.

responses.description: Full replacement list for the current P9 response map. An empty array is valid and clears all stored P9 responses. datapoint_id values are trimmed before membership and duplicate-canonical checks.
Map keyed by ESRS IG3 datapoint id and filtered to the current deterministic corpus. Keys can contain dots, for example E2.IRO-1_01.

datapoint_id.description: ESRS IG3 datapoint id. Whitespace is trimmed before storage; duplicate canonical ids after trimming return validation 422.

value.description: Sparse optional field. Null, empty, or omitted values are omitted from stored response objects and returned/exported as empty.

evidence_reference.description: Sparse optional field. Null, empty, or omitted values are omitted from stored response objects and returned/exported as empty.

note.description: Sparse optional field. Null, empty, or omitted values are omitted from stored response objects and returned/exported as empty.

not_applicable_count.description: Responses marked not_applicable. These count toward completion_ratio and completion_status.

completion_ratio.description: Completed plus not_applicable responses divided by applicable_datapoint_count, rounded to 4 decimals.

key.description: Stable DR grouping key. Uses 'unassigned' when the source row has no explicit DR.
